text:
deploy-bot: Deploy complete -> prod-eu-west-1; release=v2.8.3; staged rollout at 50%; postdeploy smoke probes started

maria: saw an early spike in synth-embed p95 in EU, roughly 4-7% of hosts showing 300-500ms vs baseline ~120ms :thinking_face:

jonathan: can you paste the probe snippet/logs? curious if it's KV warmup or kernel change from the quant flag in this release

maria: gist: `embed_synth_probe: host=eu1-12, p95=473ms, errors=0, latency_source=inference-proxy`

sre-oncall: checking cloudwatch now — seeing 503 spikes correlated with the same hosts during probe windows. stacktrace shows inference-proxy timeouts to model-server (grpc deadline exceeded)

oliver: quick thought — v2.8.3 enabled per-model quantization by default for some model variants. could cause heavier CPU work during cold KV/cache paths. change window still open for 38m

jonathan: propose: 1) pause further rollout, 2) pin traffic in prod-eu-west-1 to v2.8.2, 3) revert quant flag in next patch if confirmed. agree?

maria: +1. pausing rollout now.

deploy-bot: action: rollout paused for prod-eu-west-1 (from 50% -> hold).

maria: running a quick targeted warmup on affected hosts to see if p95 drops (prefix cache warmup + kv prefetch)

sre-oncall: i recommend pin instead of rollback while we validate warmup effect. If p95 doesn't improve within 20m, we rollback.

jonathan: doing pin: `/deploy pin prod-eu-west-1 v2.8.2 --reason "postdeploy smoke p95 spike"`

deploy-bot: pinned prod-eu-west-1 -> v2.8.2 (pin_id=pin-20260318-eu) :white_check_mark:

oliver: noted for postmortem: add a smoke probe that exercises quant path on small sample before full rollout. Also call out release notes: new quant toggle should be highlighted under "runtime flags"

maria: will open a short follow-up doc and assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml. tagging @oliver to lead triage.

jonathan: creating a GH issue and scheduling a 30m deep-dive in 10m. if warmup fixes it we unpin and continue rollout after checklist.

sre-oncall: monitoring dashboards, will escalate to incident channel if error rate > 1% sustained for 10m.

maria: thanks all — updating release notes entry and adding a line in the change window log about the hold.

deploy-bot: note: change window for this release: 2026-03-18 09:00-10:30 UTC. hold recorded by maria.

oliver: :thumbsup: good call on pin.
